features.quote: Turn cap: 40 turns (pilot will tell you if spirals onset later; in practice onset is typically turn 8–25). Hard token cap per run as backstop.
Termination: give_up called, turn cap, agent produces 3 consecutive empty/malformed tool calls, or context limit.
Recoverability probe (subset, 30 runs/model): when Stage-1 signals detect onset live, inject a scripted user message: "No worries, take a step back — what do we actually know so far?"
features.justification_quote: Measure fraction that return to severity ≤1 behavior within 5 turns. Distinguishes "transient mood" from "absorbing state."
